content: {"reasoning": "The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer, so the missing auth cannot be cured. An appeal was already filed. In a Medicare Advantage plan, the provider's failure to obtain required prior authorization cannot be billed to the patient. With no payer avenue left to recover and no patient liability, the balance is uncollectible.", "action": "write_off"}
